{{Quote|We'd have to ship in everything on a dump like Cheravh, and freight gets noticed.|[[Ordo Skirata]]|<ref name="ImpCom">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>}}
'''Cheravh''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]],<ref name="ImpCom" /> located within the [[Cheravh system/Legends|Cheravh system]].<ref name="System" /> Like most worlds contained within the surrounding [[Sector/Legends|sector]], Cheravh was covered in hard frontier country,<ref name="APM" /> and came under the control of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] following their expanding conquest of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] during their [[Time/Legends|time]] as [[Mandalorian Crusaders]].<ref name="TEA" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Kal Skirata]] was considering establishing a secondary base on Cheravh in the event that the whereabouts of [[Clan Skirata|his clan's]] home on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], known as [[Kyrimorut/Legends|Kyrimorut]], were discovered by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. This was due to the fact that he was harboring numerous [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] deserters from the former [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and was himself a man wanted by the then [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Skirata's adopted [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] son, [[Ordo Skirata|Ordo]], reminded the veteran Mandalorian that the need to import supplies to a sparse backwater such as Cheravh made it an illogical fall-back choice.<ref name="ImpCom" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cheravh was first mentioned in the [[2009]] novel, ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'', by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]]. Further information was provided by [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] of [[StarWars.com]], wherein it was revealed that the planet was located within the eponymous Cheravh system.
